column3: “David” supplies the unnamed subject; the Greek says “flesh,” rather than “body.”
BSB’s “now” matches the Textus Receptus (νὺν); the critical text lacks it. “The promised Holy Spirit” renders “the promise of the Holy Spirit.”
The Greek says “all the house of Israel,” rather than only “all Israel.”
“The people” supplies the unnamed subject; the Greek address includes “men” as well as “brothers.”
The Greek explicitly counts about three thousand “souls”; “to the believers” supplies the destination.
The Greek describes wonders happening through the apostles, rather than making them the active performers.
“Courts” and the explicit meeting are supplied for the Greek description of continuing in the temple.
“To their number” renders the Greek “together” (ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό).
